criteria.reason: Complete, ready-to-send letter covering all data categories, format, and response timeline.
Correct 30-day deadline and free access, but Art. 25 uncited and letter omits purposes, retention, sources, automated decisions.
Clear escalation path: registered follow-up, FDPIC complaint, civil action.
Brief AI/attorney disclaimer is an unnecessary caveat, though data rights strongly supported.

summary: Solid, actionable response with complete letter and correct Swiss deadlines, but omits Art. 25 citation and several Art. 25 disclosure elements, plus a brief disclaimer.
